status: planned; no live results supplied by this protocol
task: ordered bounded async mapper followed by cooperative cancellation
model: Select one exact provider/model revision in the run manifest before generation
reasoningAndSampling: Identical explicit settings across arms; record provider-supported settings and any seed
feedbackBeforeChange: prior source only; no evaluator results
changeCondition: run every arm, even when its base implementation fails
primaryEndpoints: changed implementation passes all base and change cases
secondaryEndpoints: source diff size for change, descriptive only
exclusions: No post-hoc exclusions; retain refusals, invalid code, timeouts, and incomplete outputs as failures
analysis: Report each paired replicate, exact all-pass counts, discordant pairs, and costs; descriptive pilot only
stopRule: Stop after all six paired replicates or a documented provider/resource block; publish partial runs as partial
freezeRule: Record hashes of tasks, prompts, cases, evaluator, and protocol before the first generation; changes require a new protocol version
smokeRun: One paired replicate may check plumbing but is not the preregistered six-replicate pilot
